exact_artifact_findings: v1.7.76 could create and export a valid local handoff pack but could not safely inspect a previously downloaded pack.
The release report linked evidence by filename but did not verify that all claimed files and test commands existed or that the durable backlog remained complete.
public_user_journey_findings: A user returning to a downloaded pack had no local integrity, expiry, or destination-compatibility check.
professional_staff_owner_findings: Owner visibility showed dual-track status but not whether evidence references and carry-forward obligations were complete.
defects_and_friction: A malformed, expired, mismatched, or extended JSON file could not be distinguished locally from a valid handoff pack.
A future builder could accidentally drop unresolved backlog items or cite missing tests without the dual-track schema itself detecting it.
missing_capabilities: Release evidence and backlog coverage gate
accessibility_privacy_security_data_find: Local file inspection can improve continuity without network transfer or persistent storage when unknown fields and oversize files fail closed.
deployment_and_operations_findings: Both improvements are dependency-independent and require no provider, credential, deployment, or production access.
prior_release_and_deferral_findings: v1.7.76 deferred a portal import adapter because product-local acceptance was absent; a central local inspector is a smaller safe slice that does not claim portal acceptance.
v1.7.76 preserved the 21-item backlog only after a regression exposed accidental collapse; that lesson should become an executable invariant.

creative_new_capability_candidates.reason: Completes the next safe local continuity slice without server or portal transfer.
Makes affected-file, test, limitation, source identity, and backlog-preservation evidence fail closed.
Still requires exact product-local artifact, schema, privacy, and owner acceptance.
Would violate the preserved no-automatic-transfer boundary.

product_platform_track.primary_objective: Let a user safely inspect a minimal handoff pack locally before deciding what to do next.
connected_objectives: Strict local JSON parsing and size limit

prompt_and_continuation_findings: Dual-track evidence needed executable coverage validation, not only structural validation.
schema_and_test_findings: Affected files and tests could be named without existence or package-script verification.
automation_and_recovery_findings: A deterministic gate can preserve all prior unresolved backlog IDs and exact source identity before packaging.
evidence_and_reporting_findings: Prior limitations and learning must be explicitly reviewed and linked to current evidence.
candidate_waves: Protected owner view and release test
